title: Ernie Jr.'s Jade Sound production company
summary: Junior's Hollywood production company, backed by Rene Hall, offers recording, arranging and contracting services.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I saw him this summer and I spent about a week with him, and really the high point there, as I said he's not a doctor or lawyer that I expected the first dream, but I'm just so tickled because win or lose, he's so happy with his work, at what he's doing, and he thinks he will get on to the top at what he's doing, and he's doing pretty nice. Rene Hall has been a lot of help to him and they work together a lot, he's got an office of his own. He had one for a while in the same building that Rene was in, but he wanted to enlarge so he hired a secretary and has a larger suite and everything.
Specifically what does Ernie's office involve?
him. It says, Jade Sound Incorporated, meet the professionals.

I thought about what you said last night. He says he tries to tell everybody whatever you're doing, let a professional do it. He says let's face it, you cannot produce, arrange, orchestrate music, contract quality musicians, conduct, evaluate or select engineers, rent studios, schedule sessions, select background singers, pay earnings to musicians, compute and pay federal and state taxes, social security and union funds, comply with the American Federation of Musicians and be creative. He said he tries to take that headache off of the musicians.
He said Jade Sound reduces your costs, protects your investment, leaving you freedom to create the sound that today's competitive music demands; and you know it's really competitive today.
Jade Sound applies the missing link for investors, produces artists and clients
involved in musical production. Confidential assistance in all areas of production, see your name on a hit record. And he's doing pretty nice.
That's wonderful. That's very impressive and attractive. He's at 6362 Hollywood Boulevard?
It's a little different. I really forget offhand what it is, but it's down a little farther, and a little larger. This was just a one room suite, well I believe it's about three now.
Do you have occasion now where the whole family gets together?

That's what we are trying, sometime soon, because that's the only thing that I was telling you, it looked like my daughter is happy over her job in a pretty good category. I really don't know exactly what she was saying, that she better do something
and invest in something, because of the taxes. I think Carmen's salary is thirty six or more a year, $36,000 or more a year.
